author: Myv
body:
Hello,

Me and ASquarePig (iMan) have made our first map together, Asylum!

Information

Teams: Red and Blue (this will change when we think of more creative team names)
Team Sizes: 10v10 or possibly 12v12
Duration: 8-10 minutes (more than likely 10)

Images: http://imgur.com/a/XCV1B
Download: THIS WILL BE DONE VERY SOON.
XML: Need help with this.

Please feel free to leave feedback below and suggest any alterations and refineries we should make to improve. Keep in mind this is the first map we have created to be submitted and our second ever map in general. 

Big thanks to Zintenka for WorldEdit help and XtrasBiggestFan for help with the map also!

Myv

NOTE: Whilst the map is technically complete, XML and download is still needed. Therefore this is for viewing only as of now, and so I can make refineries before final completion. Thank you!
